profiles.description: Single-thread UTF-8 -> UAX29/Merkle/tier-tree/glome composition throughput over a fixed real corpus; scalar primitive floor.
Diagnostic lower bound for one finite unique corpus under coarse whole-file scheduling; not whole-machine capacity and not single-semantic-DAG parallelism.
profiles.resource_shape: one finite corpus partitioned by indivisible whole input files across explicit CPU affinity points; managed-host workflow defaults preserve host headroom

profiles.description: Aggregate independent-stream scaling: every pinned worker executes one complete real-corpus stream so measured work grows with worker count; managed-host workflow defaults measure serviceable capacity with reserved headroom, while full saturation is explicit opt-in; not proof of one-object internal parallelism.
profiles.resource_shape: replicated independent corpus streams over explicit physical-core/SMT affinity points under a receipted serviceable-or-saturation resource grant

profiles.description: Bit-perfect Moby Dick engine roundtrip with independent cmp/SHA-256 proof.

Read-only canonical generation.forward_program benchmark over a versioned prompt/hops/fanout matrix with PRE-FLIGHT planner evidence, measured EXPLAIN ANALYZE/BUFFERS/WAL work, typed forward receipts, semantic fingerprints, stable-world proof, and exact installed execution-module binding to the built target.
profiles.execution_boundary: installed-seeded-runtime matching the exact built laplace_substrate extension/execution identity
profiles.mutability: read-only; fails if the substrate write epoch or estate counts move during the suite
profiles.resource_shape: one canonical forward-program invocation per measured case/repeat; explicit steps/hops/fanout/top-k ceilings; serviceable managed host only

suites.description: Conservative reproducible floor: single-thread core plus bit-perfect Moby roundtrip.
Single-thread floor plus measured aggregate independent-stream physical-core/SMT scaling; managed-host workflow measures serviceable capacity by default and does not claim single-DAG parallelism.
Aggregate independent-stream host scaling; serviceable capacity by default in the managed workflow, saturation only by explicit opt-in; fixed-work single-DAG scaling remains #1451.

Installed seeded canonical forward-program work receipt benchmark. The suite refuses to run unless the installed laplace_substrate extension version and content-versioned execution module exactly match the selected source build.

All source/core profiles that do not require an already-installed matching runtime: scalar floor, aggregate stream scaling, file-grain diagnostic, and Moby roundtrip. The database-backed query suite remains explicit because arbitrary target refs are not silently installed by this workflow.
